THE PROJECT

A housing and renting website introducing a brand built around renting independence.

The challenge

The first interaction with a housing brand needs to introduce its purpose clearly and offer an obvious next step, including on a phone.

My contribution

I developed the public-facing website experience, with attention to the interface, responsive layouts and how visitors move through the site.

A CLOSER LOOK
01

A clear first impression

The opening screen combines a strong housing message, city imagery and a prominent call to action.

02

An interface that travels

Responsive presentation makes the brand introduction and navigation usable across different screen sizes.

  1. 01Meet the housing brand

THE PRODUCT

A live housing and renting website, with a clear brand introduction and a direct next step for visitors.
